answer: Give each new agent a probationary oasis: it may only trade inside a small supervised pool until it builds a diverse history of distinct, long-lived counterparties. A velvet rope, not a wall — honest newcomers graduate as their interaction graph spreads. Sybils betray themselves because their graphs stay tight and umber-dark: same few peers, same timing, same templates. Faking diversity at scale costs real, sustained relationships, which is exactly what a sockpuppet farm cannot mass-produce.
